description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Shipping' class within the OpenCart admin extension controllers. The class manages shipping extension modules including listing, installing, and uninstalling shipping methods, and handles related configurations and permission checks.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, with methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling shipping modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method to output the list of shipping extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieve and compile the list of available and installed shipping extensions, generating an HTML view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Install a shipping extension, including permission checks, language loading, and configuring the extension.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstall a shipping extension, handling permission verification and cleanup.
